MINIO_ROOT_USER.name: MINIO_ROOT_USER
MINIO_ROOT_USER.description: RustFS (S3-compatible object storage, MinIO-compatible) root username. RustFS reads this variable natively. Referenced by the storage service as AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID via ${{minio.MINIO_ROOT_USER}}.

MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD.name: MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD
MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: RustFS (S3-compatible object storage, MinIO-compatible) root password — auto-generated at deploy time. RustFS reads this variable natively. Referenced by the storage service as AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY via ${{minio.MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD}}.

MINIO_ADDRESS.name: MINIO_ADDRESS
MINIO_ADDRESS.description: Legacy MinIO listen address. RustFS binds via RUSTFS_ADDRESS baked into its Dockerfile (0.0.0.0:8080); this variable is kept so existing wiring and documentation stay valid.

PORT.name: PORT
PORT.description: API port the public domain routes to. RustFS binds RUSTFS_ADDRESS (0.0.0.0:8080) and ignores $PORT, so the domain must name the container port explicitly.
